invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list due to the use of stream().collect().
No elements are dropped or added; the list is just reordered.
The input 'records' list is required for stream processing; assumed non-null during method execution.
Partition counts are typically non-negative by convention.
No null elements are introduced or removed; all records in the input are present and reordered in the result.
